text: Every morning, I wake up at six-thirty, even on weekends. After stretching for a few minutes, I drink a large glass of water and make my bed. Then, I have a simple breakfast of oatmeal and fruit while I review my schedule for the day. My work starts at eight, and I focus on my main tasks before lunch, which helps me stay productive. In the afternoon, I usually have meetings or handle emails. At around five, I go for a thirty-minute run or do yoga at home. After dinner, I relax by reading or watching a documentary, and I prepare my clothes for the next day. I’m always in bed by eleven. This routine keeps me consistent and reduces stress, and I feel it gives my days a healthy rhythm.
